tasks.title: Add a tested greeting function
tasks.objective: Create a dependency-free greeting.py module exposing greet(name: str) -> str for a small Python command-line example. Use Python's unittest library for tests under tests/.
acceptance_criteria: greeting.greet('Ada') returns exactly 'Hello, Ada!', and leading or trailing whitespace in the name is removed.
An empty or whitespace-only name raises ValueError with a helpful message.
Discoverable unittest tests exercise normal names, surrounding whitespace, and empty or whitespace-only names through the public greet function.

tasks.title: Expose the greeting as a command-line tool
tasks.objective: Extend greeting.py so python3 -m greeting NAME invokes the existing greet function. Keep it dependency-free and add public command-line tests using unittest and subprocess.
acceptance_criteria: Running python3 -m greeting Ada prints exactly 'Hello, Ada!' followed by a newline and exits with code 0.
A missing name or a whitespace-only name exits with code 2, emits a helpful error on stderr, and does not print a traceback.
Discoverable unittest tests cover successful invocation, a missing name, and a whitespace-only name through the command-line entry point; the greeting function tests continue to pass.
